Kerala Railway Funding Surges Significantly, Projects Worth ₹20,000 Crore Underway

Kerala's railway funding has increased by ten times since 2014, reaching ₹3,795 crore for FY27. Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that railway projects valued at over ₹20,000 crore are currently in progress in the state.
